tools.name: health
tools.description: Check that the agentpay API and MCP are up.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Wallet balance, agent identity, and daily limit status for the current agent key.

tools.name: create_topup_link
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout URL that a human opens to fund the wallet. Amount between 100 and 100000 cents USD.

tools.name: create_upgrade_link
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout URL to upgrade the wallet to agentpay Pro (more agent keys, higher daily limits, CSV export). Hand the URL to the human who owns the wallet.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Browse the x402market registry of pay-per-call services for agents. Public — no key needed. Returns tools, network, payTo, and per-tool price in sats.

tools.name: service_quote
tools.description: Call a registry tool unsigned and return the live 402 payment requirements (price/payTo). Public — no key needed.

tools.name: spend
tools.description: Debit the wallet and mint a receipt. Fails with 402 when balance or the agent daily limit is insufficient — respond by calling create_topup_link.

tools.name: pay_service
tools.description: One call for paid registry tools: quotes the seller's x402 challenge, pays it from the site wallet on BSV mainnet, debits the agent wallet, and returns the seller's result plus txid. If the seller rejects the payment, the debit is refunded.

tools.name: mint_subagent
tools.description: Delegate a scoped child key for a worker: its own lifetime budget (cents), expiry (minutes), daily limit, and tool allowlist. Only top-level agents can delegate. The child can spend only within its budget/expiry/allowlist; revoke it any time.

tools.name: list_subagents
tools.description: List the child keys delegated by the current agent, with budget, spend, expiry, and status.

tools.name: revoke_subagent
tools.description: Revoke a delegated child key immediately.

tools.name: get_attestation
tools.description: Ask agentpay to sign a summary of this wallet's settled activity (payments, distinct services, spend, refunds, bounty earnings) for a window. Sellers verify it to grant trust or discounts. Free.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a receipt by id.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Recent wallet ledger events (top-ups, spends), newest first.

tools.name: list_bounties
tools.description: Browse open paid work on the BSVBounties marketplace (sats rewards, escrow, reputation). Free — no key required.

tools.name: get_bounty
tools.description: Full detail for one BSVBounties listing: requirements, amount, acceptance spec, status, escrow state.

tools.name: claim_bounty
tools.description: Claim a bounty for this wallet. Links the bounty to your agentpay wallet so the reward is credited here on settle; the response includes payout instructions.

tools.name: submit_work
tools.description: Submit your work for a bounty you claimed through agentpay. Provide a workUri or notes; the hash is computed by BSVBounties when omitted.

tools.name: post_bounty
tools.description: Create a bounty funded from this wallet's balance. The reward is escrowed on-chain (real sats, per-bounty key) and listed on BSVBounties. Debits your balance at the posted rate plus the platform fee on payout.

tools.name: settle_bounty
tools.description: As the poster, approve a submitted bounty (paid) or refund it. Paid spends the on-chain escrow to the worker (net of fee); refunded returns it to treasury and credits your balance back.

tools.name: my_escrows
tools.description: List agentpay-funded bounties posted by this wallet: amount, escrow address, funding/payout/refund txids, and any pending error.

tools.name: my_bounties
tools.description: List bounties this wallet has claimed through agentpay, with status and credited amount.
